en.headline: Man found hanged at Lok Ma Chau village house, confirmed dead at scene
en.dek: Police responded to a report about 11pm on Sunday that a 35-year-old man surnamed Sin had hanged himself with a rope in a room; no suicide note was found and the cause of death is pending autopsy.
body: Police received a report at about 11pm on Sunday that a man was suspected of having hanged himself at a village house on the Mai Po section of Castle Peak Road in Lok Ma Chau.
Firefighters cut down the 35-year-old man surnamed Sin, and he was confirmed dead at the scene.
Preliminary investigation indicated that he had used a rope about two metres long in a room. No suicide note was found at the scene.
The cause of death is pending an autopsy. It was understood that the man had been unhappy over financial issues.

zh.headline: 落馬洲米埔村屋35歲男子疑上吊 現場證實不治
zh.dek: 周日晚上約11時，有人報案指青山公路米埔段一村屋有男子上吊，消防到場解下35歲冼姓男子後證實死亡，現場無遺書，死因待驗屍確定。
body: 警方周日晚上約11時接獲報案，指有人懷疑其朋友在落馬洲青山公路米埔段一間村屋上吊。
消防人員到場將35歲姓冼的男子解下，他被證實當場死亡。
初步調查相信男子在房間內用一條約2米長的繩子上吊，現場沒有檢獲遺書。
死因有待驗屍後確定。據悉男子曾因金錢問題感到不開心。
